Mahesh Garg vs Dr. Sudam Pandharinath Khade ... on 1
February, 2024 
Author: Chief Justice
Bench: Ravi Malimath, Vijay Kumar Shukla

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Ravi Malimath,
 Chief Justice
 &
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vijay Kumar Shukla
 On The 1 st Of February, 2024 
 Contempt Petition Civil No. 4850 of 2023
 Between:-
 Mahesh Garg S/O Late Shri Rajkumar Garg,
 Aged About 71 Years, 16 Sanwad Nagar,
 Navalakha District Indore (Madhya Pradesh)
 ...
 (By Shri Pratyush Mishra - Advocate) 
 And
 1. Dr. Sudam Pandharinath Khade
 Commissioner Food Safety And Control
 Food And Durg Administration Idgaah
 Hills District Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)
 2. Mr. Iiayaraja T. , Collector Indore
 Collectorate, Moti Tabela, Indore
 (Madhya Pradesh)
 3.  MR. S.K. SUMAN, COLLECTOR JABALPUR  COLLECTORATE CAMPUS ROAD, SOUTH CIVIL  LINES, JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 4. MR. AKSHAY KUMAR SINGH, COLLECTOR  G WA L I O R COLLECTOR, VIDHYA NAGAR,
 GWALIOR (MADHYA PRADESH) 
 .....R  ( S H R I BHUWAN DESHMUKH - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR  RESPONDENT NO.1 AND SHRI ANAND BHATT - GOVERNMENT  ADVOCATE FOR THE RESPONDENT NO.2)
 This petition coming on for admission this day, Hon'ble Mahesh Garg vs Dr. Sudam Pandharinath Khade ... on 1 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65142622/
1 Signature Not Verified Signed by: SANTOSH MASSEY Signing time: 01-02-2024 19:32:46  2  Ravi Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 ORDER This petition has been filed on the ground that the order dated 07.02.2022 passed in W.P. No.2937 of 2022 has been disobeyed. In terms whereof, the Court ordered in paras 12 and 13 as follows:-
"12. Given the above, there is no dispute by the State Government for the establishment of three labs at Indore, Jabalpur and Gwalior and up-gradation of the lab at Bhopal. The land for the construction of the lab in all three places has been allotted. An administrative sanction, allotment of the fund has been done. Now the only implementation is to be done in a time frame manner. The construction work of the lab at Indore has already been started and as of December 2021, 80% of work has been completed, therefore, Food Testing Laboratories Indore can be started its functioning this year and we hope and trust the respondents shall make all efforts to complete this task by the end of this year 2022. So far as the construction of the Food Testing Laboratories at Jabalpur and Gwalior is concerned, there is no status report on record after allotment of the land. Since the Government has already taken a decision and process has already been initiated by allotment of land and sanctioning the fund, therefore, same can also be started and with the task to complete within a period of one year from today. The Collectors Indore, Jabalpur and Gwalior are directed to make all possible efforts all the three Food safety Laboratories at their respective places must start functioning within one year from today. We hereby direct respondents no. 2 to 5 to submit progress reports after 4 months in the office of Principal registrar of High Court of Madhya Pradesh Bench at Indore through the office of the Advocate General. 
13. With the aforesaid directions the Public Interest Litigation is disposed of. The office is directed to list this writ petition for submitting the compliance report before the Principal Registrar. At the end, we would like to record our appreciation for the petitioner for raising this important issue by filling this Public Interest Litigation." 
On considering the same, we do not find that any contempt would arise in this matter. The contempt would arise only when there is a willful disobedience being committed by the accused. In the instant case, in our considered view, the Court should not have passed an order directing compliance within a period of one year in a subject matter in which the Court is not an expert. However, to hold that the Court hopes and trusts that the respondents shall make efforts to complete the task by the end of the year 2022 is quite a different matter. There can be only way of persuasion so far as the issue is concerned. In our considered view, there cannot be a direction to complete setting up of the food safety laboratories in a time that is specified by the Court itself. Therefore, we do not find that any contempt would arise.

2 However, we take notice of the submissions made by the respondents that every effort would be made for establishing the food safety laboratories and making them functional. 
The petition is disposed off accordingly. 
 (RAVI MALIMATH) (VIJAY K  CHIEF JUSTICE   skm Mahesh Garg vs Dr. Sudam Pandharinath Khade ... on 1 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65142622/
